The color additive D&C Violet No. 2 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of §74.1602(a)(1) and (b) [1].  
21 CFR 82.1602 [1] requires that D&C Violet No. 2 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of §74.1602(a)(1) and (b).  
21 CFR 82.1050 [2] requires that a batch of a straight color listed in this subpart may be certified for use only in drugs and cosmetics if such batch conforms to the requirements of §82.5 and to the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color.
